decision: D-076 (the user's "Hybrid (Recommended)" of 2026-11-07, on tasks/T-070/artifacts/design.md section 6.2): P3 sizes each core family's phase from that family's own knee (C-096)
status: pre-data: written before any P3 capture. It supersedes ml/l7_pools.py's module note on L7 v2 intensity, and says how docs/P3_DATASET_DESIGN.md:185 ('{0.5, 1, 2} x that family's knee') is carried out
knees: each of C2, C3a and C3b from its own value in P1's knees file (eval/p1_analysis.py --ladder). A family named in no_knee is sized at its top tested level (top_tested in that file: the highest level whose repeats all had a sound attempt) and marked so; a family with neither is a refusal. A pilot plan without knees keeps the placeholder sizing and says so
target: m x K per phase, m from ml/p3_prereg.json volume.phase_intensity_multipliers: in S for C2 and C3a, in bots for C3b
room: the family's registered entities (ml/l7_pools.py POPULATIONS l7v2, at least volume.attack_entities_per_core_family_min): the 300 verified addresses leave no more

carrier.C2: the room's entities, each at the Poisson rate m x K x S / (n x cost) (ml/l7_pools.py c2_rps), as before but from C2's own knee
carrier.C3a: the room's entities, then pace: page gaps divided by f = (m x K x S / per-source cost rate) / entities, with f at most pace_cap, P1's per-source pace times 2; below 1 the pace slows
carrier.C3b: count only: the room's bots, whose frozen parameters do not change; C3b@M1 rides along as registered

manifest: per core phase in the plan's intensity.phases: family, m, knee, no_knee, unit, target, realized, shortfall, excess, entities, pace_factor
